e268d30e-59e5-4d1a-8104-c57c0ead8912.title: Toza nam mato
e268d30e-59e5-4d1a-8104-c57c0ead8912.content: Toza, nam matoni muzlatkichda sovuting va chaqaloqqa uni chaynashga ruxsat bering.

e90cc935-e345-454f-84f3-c300a7e97793.title: Milklarni yengil massaj qilish
e90cc935-e345-454f-84f3-c300a7e97793.content: Toza barmog‘ingiz bilan chaqalog‘ingizning milklarini aylana harakatlar bilan ohista massaj qiling.

30255b45-90fc-46ab-8b8c-9ce75952377f.title: Xavfsiz tish chiqarish o‘yinchoqlari
30255b45-90fc-46ab-8b8c-9ce75952377f.content: BPA saqlamaydigan, zaharli bo‘lmagan tish chiqarish o‘yinchoqlarini tanlang. Bo‘g‘ilish xavfini tug‘dirishi mumkin bo‘lgan mayda qismlari bor o‘yinchoqlardan saqlaning.

3fbd0995-1618-49b3-aa8c-f8ff75c52bc6.title: Birinchi tishni parvarishlash
3fbd0995-1618-49b3-aa8c-f8ff75c52bc6.content: Birinchi tish ko‘rinishi bilanoq, chaqaloqlar uchun mo‘ljallangan yumshoq tish cho‘tkasi va faqat suv yordamida tishni tozalashni boshlang.

5c0c2cd7-bbc3-4acf-aa29-a75ff9325110.title: Shakardan saqlaning
5c0c2cd7-bbc3-4acf-aa29-a75ff9325110.content: Tishlarning erta kariyesga uchrashining oldini olish uchun, ayniqsa uxlashdan oldin, shakarli oziq-ovqat va ichimliklardan saqlaning.

5d8e7654-1e68-474f-b792-610a380b7688.title: Muntazam ravishda stomatolog ko‘rigidan o‘tish
5d8e7654-1e68-474f-b792-610a380b7688.content: Chaqaloqni birinchi tug‘ilgan kunidan oldin yoki birinchi tishi ko‘rinishi bilanoq stomatolog ko‘rigiga olib borishni rejalashtiring.

6e21f5d7-f642-4d33-9bfc-bd32e68b561c.title: Sovutilgan tish chiqarish halqalari
6e21f5d7-f642-4d33-9bfc-bd32e68b561c.content: Tish chiqarish halqalarini muzlatkichda saqlang. Ularni hech qachon muzlatmang, chunki ular chaqaloqning milklariga zarar yetkazadigan darajada sovuq bo‘lishi mumkin.

9dc209b1-6f09-4b82-b44f-3bc06493d519.title: So‘lakdan paydo bo‘ladigan toshmaning oldini olish
9dc209b1-6f09-4b82-b44f-3bc06493d519.content: Chaqaloqning iyagi va bo‘ynini quruq tuting. So‘lakdan paydo bo‘ladigan toshmaning oldini olish uchun yumshoq himoya kremini surting.
